role: Independent adversarial source and hardware evidence review

resolved_findings.finding: One-second outer ACK timeout can cancel receive with a partial buffered frame, corrupting the resend ACK
resolved_findings.resolution: Reset assembler before each capability write while retaining command serialization and queued complete notifications; real channel gated test forces outer cancellation before inner reset.

resolved_findings.finding: Unicode trim in physical DIS read disagreed with new exact ASCII-trimmed detection policy
resolved_findings.resolution: Physical DIS read uses trim_ascii and canonical DIS service UUID; ambiguous formerly recognized FI033-containing identity fails closed instead of silently selecting Mini orientation.

independent_validation.note: Run included47devicecases and8newretrycases. Subsequent zero-timeout guard/canonicalservice changes statically reviewed; root final gate covers frozen source.

verified_invariants: One serialized delivery guard spans exactly one read-only capability resend
All writes and ACK waits share original ten-second deadline
Terminal error/cancellation retires uncertain session; constructor error disconnects
No print/image command retry or ModelSpec/orientation preparation change
Width/height authoritative; exact FI033 needs600x800, exact FI017 needs800x800; conflicts rejected
Late duplicate model ACK cannot acknowledge battery/film/history selector; fresh hardware polls remain

hardware_review.note: Baseline1 delayed harness collection was corrected using first attempt start to first successful end; original collection latency retained. Candidate healthy paths remain similar to healthy baseline. Baseline2 had real missing model ACK then recovery. Current candidate captures are healthy single-query runs, so do not infer missed-ACK speedup from them.
hardware_review.verdict: No source or installed runtime acceptance blocker. Missed first-ACK improvement is deterministic-test validated, not physically measured in healthy candidate/installed starts.

final_normal_review.running_log_review_scope: Current-boot Bridge and manager service journal, including native stderr markers; no kernel-log claim. Historical messages retained. Raw journal private.

final_verdict: Approved: source, no-film installed reconnect/freshness/UI, and restored normal runtime acceptance pass. Retry acceleration is deterministically tested; no physical missed-reply speedup was observed in healthy candidate/installed starts.
